title: New York nanotech hub adds immersion scanner

passages.locator: Main text, paragraphs 1–4 and interview with IBM’s John Warlaumont
passages.note: Lammers identifies the installed Albany AT:1150i as a retrofit of the dry 1150. Warlaumont, IBM’s director of lithography systems and mask development, identifies the 1150i as a learning tool for defects caused by adding water, and describes IBM’s immersion work at Veldhoven and Albany. The retrofit identification is the reporter’s account, not separately attributed to Warlaumont.
